en.why: Every rib shows the same content compressed to 0.6 of its width, so the word breaks into offset vertical slices. Each rib also carries cylinder shading on top of the letters (dark left edge, a bright band near the left, darker falloff to the right), so the glass shading sits on the letters as well as in the gaps. The streaks are already on screen at frame 0 and the word starts rising at 1.4s. The lockup starts rising at 5.2s, while the last of the word is still lifting out, so the two overlap inside the blur and the screen is never empty. The rib shading starts to fade at 6.3s. Around the title it goes to zero, leaving faint lines only on the three ribs at each side. The only color is ice blue #7fc8ff.
spec: Timing

Film 10s, starting on lit streaks with no black lead-in. Streaks rise 0–3.4s (four per rib, 0.9–1.3s each, the first already part-way up at frame 0); PRO rises in 1.4–3.55s (1.55s per rib, staggered over about 0.6s); highlight sweep 3.0–4.8s; push-in 4.7–6.1s (1.4s, 42 frames); PRO lifts out 4.8–5.4s (0.42s per rib, staggered over about 0.15s); lockup rises 5.2–6.7s (1.25s per rib, staggered over about 0.22s); blur-to-sharp 5.7–7.4s; glass flattens 5.95–7.4s (1.2s per rib); rib shading fades 6.3–7.9s; sub line 7.4–8.2s (0.8s); closing shimmer 8.0–9.8s
Easing

PRO and lockup entrances expo.out; streak rise power2.in (accelerating); PRO exit power2.in; camera descent power3.out; push-in power4.out; glass flattening power2.inOut; blur clearing power2.out; drift sine.out
Camera

2600px perspective. 0–1.15s holds at a 66° high angle with the lid leaning back 8°; 1.15–4.7s the angle lowers to 14° (3.55s) while scale goes 1.0→1.2; from 4.7s it pushes to 1.36× in 1.4s and squares up to the lid (8° angle), moving the view down 58px so the lid's bottom edge meets the frame bottom and the keyboard is out of frame, with the screen bezel and notch still in frame; then a 3.9s drift to 1.4×
Subject

Lid 1116×704px (12px screen bezel, 8px lid edge thickness, ice-blue rim light on the edge), deck 1160×740px (14px front lip, dim backlit keys with an arrow cluster, ice-blue floor reflection). Screen 1092×680px in 28 ribs, 39px wide. Each rib holds a full copy of the word, compressed horizontally to 0.6× (the refraction), entering at 1.7× width, stretched vertically 5–8× and settling to 1×, with a random offset of ±9px horizontal and none vertical. Each rib has cylinder shading over the letters (left edge 60% black fading to 0 by 12% of the width, a 50% ice-white band about 7px from the left edge, darkening from 44% of the width to 78% black on the right), its own vertical brightness (47%–100%), four thin texture lines, a 2px specular line on its left edge, and an ice-blue glow from 46% at the foot to 9% at the top. Word: Inter 800 448px, vertical gradient #ffffff → #dcefff → #7fc8ff
Sync

The PRO exit runs 4.8–5.4s and the lockup starts rising at 5.2s, so they overlap for about 0.2s while the whole screen is under the 3.5px blur. The lockup arrives at 0.6× compression with ±6px per-rib offsets, then each rib returns to 1× between 5.95s and 7.4s. Rib shading, edge lines and texture lines hold until 6.3s, then fade over 1.3s per rib. The middle ribs go to 0 and the three ribs at each side keep their lines at 30%. The foot glow drops to 23–30% in the middle ribs and 38–50% in the three edge ribs. The blur returns to 0 between 5.7s and 7.4s
Style

Pure black background, charcoal laptop, one accent: ice blue #7fc8ff. Sub line Inter 500 22px: Opal Display · 2,000 nits peak · 120 Hz. Lockup Inter 640 176px, Novis near-white, Pro in an ice-blue gradient. The end frame keeps the bezel, the notch and faint vertical ribs on the three ribs at each side, with a clean field around the lockup

en.title: Fluted Glass Effect: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: Light streaks rise through 28 glass ribs on a laptop screen and form a big word; the camera pushes in, the glass flattens and the title sharpens.
en.lede: A laptop screen is split into 28 vertical glass ribs. Light streaks rise through the ribs and settle into a big word. The camera then pushes into the screen, the word lifts out, the title rises in, the glass flattens and the blur clears into a lockup with only a few faint ribs left at the screen edges.
en.name: Fluted Glass Effect

body.h2: How to make a Fluted Glass Effect with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Split the screen into 28 vertical ribs, 39px wide on a 1092×680px screen, and put a full copy of the word in each one. Scale each copy horizontally to 0.6 around the rib's center and offset it by ±9px horizontally with no vertical offset, so the word breaks into slices like fluted glass. Shade each rib like a cylinder over the letters (dark left edge, a bright band about 7px in, darker falloff to the right), give it its own vertical brightness and a 2px specular line on its left edge, and keep a soft ice-blue glow from 46% at the foot to 9% at the top.

The film opens on lit streaks: four per rib rise with power2.in from 0s, then the word rises in from 520–780px below at 1.4s, stretched 5–8× and settling to 1× over 1.55s with expo.out. The camera lowers from a 66° to a 14° angle over 3.55s with power3.out, and a highlight sweeps across the ribs from 3.0s to 4.8s.

At 4.7s the camera pushes 1.4s to 1.36× and moves down 58px so the lid's bottom edge meets the frame bottom. The word lifts out between 4.8s and 5.4s and the new title (Inter 640, 176px) starts rising at 5.2s at 0.6× compression. Between 5.95s and 7.4s each rib goes back to 1× while a 3.5px blur clears, and the rib shading fades to nothing around the title by 7.9s, leaving faint lines on the three ribs at each side. Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard, then render an MP4 with HyperFrames.

en.alt: The word PRO seen through vertical ribbed glass on a laptop screen against black.
faq: How do you make a fluted glass effect in CSS?

Cut the element into narrow vertical strips and put a copy of the content in each. Scale each copy horizontally around the strip's center, usually to 0.5–0.7, and offset it a few pixels. The strips then show shifted slices of the same content, like a ribbed pane.
Why do the streaks come before the word?

The streaks are already rising at 0s and the word starts rising at 1.4s, so the light is on screen about 1.4s before any letter. The word is also stretched 5–8× vertically while it rises, so it looks like a streak until it settles.

zh.lede: 笔记本屏幕被切成 28 条竖向棱镜，亮线从下往上穿过玻璃，收成大字；镜头推进屏幕后，字被抽走，字标升起，玻璃变平，字标从模糊变清晰，只在屏幕左右各留 3 条淡线。
zh.name: 棱镜玻璃效果

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做棱镜玻璃效果
body.body:
把屏幕切成 28 条竖向棱，1092×680px 的屏幕里每条宽 39px，每条放一份完整的字。每份字以条中心为原点横向缩放到 0.6，再随机错位横向 ±9px，竖向不错位，字就被切成像棱镜玻璃一样的错位竖片。每条在字面上叠一层圆柱明暗（左边缘暗、约 7px 处一条亮带、右侧渐暗），再加各自的竖向明暗、左边缘一条 2px 的高光线，以及从底部 46% 渐弱到顶部 9% 的冰蓝柔光。

开场就是亮着的亮线：0s 起每条升起四道（power2.in），1.4s 字从下方 520–780px 处升起，竖向拉伸 5–8 倍，用 expo.out 1.55s 落回 1 倍。镜头用 power3.out 在 3.55s 内从 66° 降到 14° 俯角，3.0s 到 4.8s 一道高光逐条扫过棱条。

4.7s 起镜头用 1.4s 推到 1.36 倍并下移 58px，盖板下沿落在画面底边。字在 4.8s 到 5.4s 被抽走，新字标（Inter 640，176px）5.2s 起以 0.6 倍压缩升起，5.95s 到 7.4s 每条逐条变回 1 倍，同时 3.5px 模糊散去，7.9s 前字标周围的棱条阴影淡到 0，只在屏幕左右各 3 条留淡线。点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill，再用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4。

zh.alt: 黑底上的笔记本屏幕里，PRO 字样隔着竖条纹玻璃显示。
faq: 棱镜玻璃效果用 CSS 怎么做？
把元素切成窄的竖条，每条里放一份内容副本。每份副本以条中心为原点横向缩放，一般取 0.5 到 0.7，再错位几个像素。每条显示同一内容的不同片段，就像一块条纹玻璃。
为什么亮线比字先出现？
亮线 0s 就已经在升起，字 1.4s 才开始升起，屏幕上先有约 1.4s 只有光、没有字。字升起时还被竖向拉伸 5 到 8 倍，在落定前看起来就是一条亮线。
